## Catalysts / what to watch
- **F3Q26 print — REPORTED June 24, 2026 (massive beat-and-raise).** Actuals $41.5B rev / 84.9% GM, F4Q26 guide $50B / ~86% / $31 EPS, 16 SCAs disclosed — see Current state. Next print: F4Q26 (August). Watch SCA roster expansion toward the >50%-of-revenue target, HBM4 ramp, and the capital-return launch post-Dec 2026 CHIPS Act anniversary.
- **🆕🔴🔴🔴 F4Q26 (Aug) PRINT — DUE ~2026-09-30, AND THE BOGEY SET IS NOW EXPLICIT AND COMPARABLE (full tables in `## Intra-quarter`, 09-23 block).** Quarter: guide **$50.0bn ± $1bn / ~86% GM / $31.00 ± $1.00**; Street **$50,450mn / 85.1% / $31.16**; **UBS $52,434mn / 87.6% / $32.50**; BofA publishes no quarter point on purpose. Guide-for-FQ1 (Nov): **UBS models $59,346mn / 88.6% / $37.04 and expects MU to guide "$58-59bn" against a ~$57bn Street** — so a **$58bn+ FQ1 guide is the line that separates a beat from an in-line**. **THE FOUR THINGS TO LISTEN FOR, IN PRIORITY ORDER: (1) FY27 GROSS-MARGIN LANGUAGE — BofA's whole preview is "mid-80s% for FY27E" while UBS models 90.2% CY27 and a ~91% peak in C4Q27/C1Q28; that ~500bp house gap is the single biggest unresolved forecast on the page and management's phrasing settles it. (2) FY27 CAPEX — UBS ~$51bn vs BofA "mid to h
- HBM4 volume ramp in CQ2 2026 for NVIDIA Vera Rubin; HBM4E (custom base die) into CY27. Watch MU's HBM4 base-die redesign / qual progress vs Samsung-Hynix (Jefferies/Inspectrum, 2025-12-17).
- **🆕🔴🔴 THE RUBIN-GENERATION STACK-HEIGHT LADDER — NOW THE HIGHEST-VALUE SETTLEABLE ITEM ON THIS PAGE, BECAUSE IT IS A SPEC AND NOT A FORECAST.** As of 2026-09-06 the page carries **Rubin at 12-Hi HBM4** (Jefferies Asia TMT specialist SALES · Conor O'Mara, 09-06 — ⚠️ SALES DESK COMMENTARY, NOT RESEARCH, relaying TrendForce / ET News) **against UBS's own house view that NVIDIA already moved VR/R300 to HBM4 8-Hi** (UBS Korea Summit first read, 2026-08-25) — and **Rubin Ultra at 8-Hi HBM4, "around one-third fewer than 12-Hi in Rubin"** (Morgan Stanley · Charlie Chan et al., "SEMICON Taiwan 2026 key takeaways", 09-06; ⚠️ MS's own wording is "Rubin Ultra **CPU**", ambiguous, not corrected here). **WATCH FOR, IN PRIORITY ORDER: (1) any NVIDIA primary platform spec or memory-maker qualification disclosure that fixes the Rubin and Rubin Ultra stack heights; (2) the END-S
- Additional SCA signings / disclosure of structure (floor pricing, cancellation terms) — the re-rating catalyst.
(Three sources, all previews of the **F4Q26 (Aug) print due ~2026-09-30**: **UBS · Timothy Arcuri / Gianmarco Vella / Stacy Che**, *"Micron Technology Inc — FQ4:26 (Aug) Preview: Fundamentals Continue to Tighten as the Debate Shifts to Duration"*, **2026-09-23**, 24pp, **Buy, 12m PT US$1,625 (UNCHANGED)**, px US$1,096.16 (22-Sep) — [source](../relat%C3%B3rios%20bons/ued51886.html) · **BofA Securities · Vivek Arya / Duksan Jang / Michael Mani / Liam Pharr**, *"Micron Technology, Inc. Q4 Preview: Focus on GM Durability and Buyback Timing, not on pricing mechanics"*, **2026-09-22**, **Buy, PO US$1,550 (UNCHANGED, established 24-Jun-2026)**, px US$1,096.16 — [source](../relat%C3%B3rios%20bons/20260922_BofA_Securities_MU_Micron_Technology-_Inc-_Q4_Preview-_Focus_on_GM_Durabili.html) · **FundaAI**, *"Preview\|MU FY26Q4: Focusing on Earnings Sustainability; A Higher, Longer Plateau"*,

🔴🔴🔴 **THE BOGEY SET, ON ONE BASIS, BECAUSE THE PRINT IS THE NEXT EVENT ON THIS PAGE. Everything in the first block is F4Q26 (Aug quarter); the guide column is MU's own from the 24-Jun call.**

- 🔴🔴🔴 **THE SINGLE LARGEST ESTIMATE MOVE IN THE WINDOW, AND IT IS NOT THE PRINT QUARTER — IT IS THE TERMINAL YEAR THE PT RESTS ON. UBS takes **C2029E EPS from ~$165 to ~$219 (+33%)** and simultaneously cuts the target multiple from **~11x to ~8x NTM P/E**, so the **PT stays at exactly $1,625**.** The full bridge as UBS prints it: C2029 EPS $219 → discounted back to C2028 at a **12.2% CoE** (10yr T-yield 5.00% from 4.57%, ERP 3.75%, beta 1.92) → **$195 present-value-equivalent C2028E EPS × 8x = $1,625**. ➤➤ 🔴 **THIS IS THE REASON TO READ THE NOTE RATHER THAN THE HEADLINE: an unchanged price target is concealing a 33% raise to the out-year earnings power AND a 27% de-rate of the multiple applied to it. The page's prior description of the UBS valuation — *"15x C2029E EPS ~$124-125"* (06-25) — is now two revisions stale and is moved to Changelog.** ⚠️ **UBS's o
- 🔴🔴 **THE FULL UBS ESTIMATE LADDER, CY AND FY, BECAUSE THE PAGE HAS BEEN MIXING THEM.** FY-Aug: **$74.70 / $184.19 / $274.97 / $240.04** (FY26/27/28/29E, vs prior $74.13 / $184.89 / $265.65). CY: **$106.87 / $212.17 / $277.19 / $219.15** (CY26/27/28/29E, vs prior $106.91 / $210.07 / $262.22 / $165.37). Revenue FY: **$131,393 / $282,154 / $376,822 / $304,355mn**. FCF FY: **$50,837 / $146,963 / $201,281mn** (26/27/28E). ⚠️⚠️ **BASIS GUARD, AND IT IS LOAD-BEARING FOR THE RECONCILIATION: UBS's CY29E EPS FALLS to $219.15 from CY28E $277.19 — the model carries a DOWN-CYCLE (FY29 revenue −19%, FY30 −20%), and the $1,625 PT is anchored on the FIRST DOWN YEAR, not on the peak. Anyone comparing $1,625 to a peak-EPS multiple is comparing the wrong two numbers.** UBS's own framing: *"even assuming ~80% decline in open market pricing on the other side of the cycle (starting in C2
**🆕🔴🔴🔴 2026-09-20 (/wiki-ingest 21h) — TEN DAYS BEFORE THE F4Q26 PRINT, THE BUY-SIDE BOGEYS ARE ON PAPER AND THEY ARE **6% ABOVE SELL-SIDE ON THE GUIDE** — WHILE **60% OF THE SAME RESPONDENTS SAY THEY ARE LEANING BEARISH.** THAT COMBINATION IS THE SETUP, AND IT IS UNUSUAL ENOUGH THAT THE POLLSTER FLAGS IT HIMSELF. SEPARATELY, CXMT PUT ITS G5 NODE INTO MASS PRODUCTION ~TWO YEARS AHEAD OF MORGAN STANLEY'S OWN EXPECTATION.**

### 🔴🔴🔴 (A) THE BUY-SIDE BOGEYS INTO 30-SEPT — BofA's POLL, AND THE ONE LINE THE POLLSTER DOESN'T BELIEVE

(BofA TMT specialist sales · **Brian Fenske** / Annie Liu, *"BofA TMT WEEKLY IDEA BANK"*, **2026-09-20**. ⚠️ **SALES COMMENTARY, EXPLICITLY NOT RESEARCH — an informal poll of BofA's distribution list, unscientific, self-selected respondents. No rating, no price target, no BofA estimate is carried in this document.**)

| MU bogey (buy-side poll) | Buy-side | Sell-side | Gap |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| F4Q26 revenue | **$54.2B** | ~$51B | **+6.3%** |
| F4Q26 gross margin | **87.1%** | 86% | +110bps |
| F1Q27 revenue **guide** | **$59.6B** | — | **+6% above sell-side** |
| F1Q27 gross margin guide | **87.7%** | — | — |
| F1Q27 EPS guide | **$37.50** | — | — |
| FY27 capex | **$48B** | — | — |
| FY27 EPS | **$183** | — | — |
| FY28 capex | **$63B** | — | — |
| FY28 EPS | **$243** | — | — |

- ⚠️⚠️ **FENSKE SMELL-TESTS HIS OWN DATA AND THE PAGE SHOULD TOO — THE F1Q27 EPS BOGEY IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT WITH THE TWO LINES ABOVE IT.** Verbatim: *"FQ1 EPS Guidance: $37.50, we heard but that seems high…smell test. To me. (Just seeing that revs are 6% above, GMs only 110bps above…)"* ➤ **He is right, and it is worth stating why: revenue 6% above and gross margin only ~1pp above cannot compound into an EPS bogey of that size unless opex is being held flat in dollars against a 6% higher revenue base. Treat $37.50 as the LEAST reliable cell in the table — the revenue and margin bogeys are the ones to trade against.**
- 🔴🔴🔴 **THE POSITIONING LINE IS THE ACTUAL SIGNAL, AND IT CONTRADICTS THE NUMBERS ABOVE IT:** *"about **60% of the respondents said they were leaning more cautious/bearish**. I don't often get that skewed of a response. I'm not making too much of it, as there are multiple other ways to 'play' memory and I didn't ask views on SKHY, Samsung, SNDK, Kioxia, and perhaps we're just seeing **MU is the least favorite near-term, if stack ranked**."* ➤➤ **A buy side carrying estimates 6% above the Street while saying it is positioned cautiously is a buy side that expects a beat it does not expect to get paid for. That is the same conclusion the 09-16 Barclays desk survey reached from a different instrument — memory collapsing from 50% to 18% of preferred sector longs — and it is now corroborated at the single-name level.**
- 🔴🔴 **THE SAME NOTE'S "BLUE SKY" EXERCISE, LOGGED AS ARITHMETIC AND NOT AS A CALL.** Fenske re-ran an EPS poll he has run repeatedly since late May, applied the **52-week-high prices (set mid-to-late June 2026)** to the buy-side EPS of that vintage to recover the multiple, and then applied those June multiples to today's revised buy-side CY28 EPS. On that exercise **STX, [[MRVL]], [[SNDK]], MU and [[WDC]] would all at least double from here.** ⚠️⚠️ **Explicitly not research and explicitly not a forecast — his own caveat is *"rates are after all 50bps higher now."* What the exercise does establish cleanly is DIRECTION OF THE DE-RATING: the buy-side's own numbers went UP while the multiples went DOWN, so the drawdown in these names is entirely multiple, not estimate.
